nodes.event: Normal traffic progression along multi-lane carriageway
Sudden deceleration and loss of traction/balance by the motorcycle
Motorcycle falls and skids across the lane; rider and passenger crash onto the asphalt
Trailing vehicles (White SUV and Silver Sedan) apply defensive braking to avert collision
Rider and pillion recover to their feet, secure dislodged headgear, and assess the fallen motorcycle while traffic diverts

causal_relations.mechanism: Loss of two-wheeler directional stability and wheel traction caused the vehicle to drop and slide.
Obstruction in active driving lanes prompted immediate evasive braking from adjacent and following motorists.
Crash resulted in dislodged safety gear and brief traffic obstruction until occupants stood up.

root_cause_analysis.primary_factor: Abrupt braking / traction failure on the two-wheeler leading to a low-side slide
contributing_factors: Moderate traffic density requiring variable speed adjustments
Proximity to surrounding multi-lane traffic reducing reaction margin
mitigating_factors: Adequate following distance maintained by trailing four-wheelers preventing secondary collision
Occupants were ambulatory and cleared the travel path promptly
